p3_b1.ocr: TABLE 4: Physicians' advice regarding the frequency and/or duration with which aerobic and strength-conditioning exercise should be performed during the first trimester

p3_b2.ocr: Physicians were asked about the advice given to pregnant patients with no obstetric complications who exercised during the first and second trimesters regarding aerobic and strength-training exercise (duration and intensity) during the third trimester (Table 5). The prevailing recommendation is no change in aerobic or strength-conditioning exercise (57%; n=39 and 41%; n=28, respectively), but many respondents recommend a decrease in aerobic or strength-training activity (25%; n=23 and 32%; n=22), or do not discuss this with their patients (18%; n=12 and 25%; n=17).
